Two Header Auth credentials: (1) Orchestrator inbound webhook and Control Plane Proxy webhook (Authorization). (2) Excel Tools X-API-Key — header name X-API-Key, value = API_KEY from excel-tools.env — on Agent — Excel Extractor HTTP nodes. Do not put the Excel key in a Set or item JSON.

ui_configuration: Field import is runtime_import_order (9 core JSON). Lab also imports support/demo-agent.workflow.json.
Do not create n8n Data Tables for live case state.

Bind Orchestrator — MAS: Call Knowledge Retrieval → MAS — Knowledge Retrieval (selector target_base=orchestrator_routing). Bind Call Knowledge Retrieval on Excel Extractor (excel_protocol) and Schedule Builder (schedule_mvp). Agents are NOT bound as nodes: Orchestrator's universal Call agent (n8n) takes the workflow id from agent_registry.invoke (seeded by Control Plane Proxy schema). After UI import n8n assigns new ids — copy each agent workflow id (URL of the open workflow) into MAS — Runtime Config → agent_workflow_ids as {"excel_extractor":"<id>","schedule_builder":"<id>"}. Adding an agent = import its workflow + POST {"operation":"upsert_agent","row":{...}} to the Control Plane Proxy (no orchestrator regen).

Bind Runtime endpoints / Runtime configuration → MAS — Runtime Config on Orchestrator, Excel Extractor, and Schedule Builder. Edit the four URLs once in MAS — Runtime Config (lab Docker DNS in git; field = http://<IP-Windows>:8200/:8000/:8090/:8100). math_url has no /agent/run suffix.
Excel Tools X-API-Key: Header Auth credential (header name X-API-Key) on Agent — Excel Extractor HTTP / toolHttpRequest nodes. Do not store the key in MAS — Runtime Config.

Windows host needs Python 3.11-3.13 venv only (no Node, no Docker). Calculation agent is agent_registry.invoke {kind:http,url:"{math_url}/agent/run"} — math_url from MAS — Runtime Config, no /agent/run suffix there. Do not import Agent — Calculation (Math Service).
Bind Header Auth on Orchestrator webhook and Control Plane Proxy webhook. Activate Control Plane Proxy first, POST {"operation":"schema"}, then start Activity.
Settings → Error workflow = Error — MAS Node Traces on Orchestrator, Excel Extractor, Schedule Builder, Retrieval, Ingestion. Not on the error workflow itself or Control Plane Proxy.

Seed agent_registry via Control Plane Proxy schema (excel_extractor, calculation_agent, schedule_builder). Orchestrator calls Knowledge Retrieval with target_base=orchestrator_routing (routing_card only). Excel LLM path uses excel_protocol; Schedule LLM path uses schedule_mvp.

Optional: Activity Knowledge → Загрузить в RAG (MAS — Knowledge Ingestion). Live Excel/Schedule LLM paths call the same Retrieval with excel_protocol / schedule_mvp. Bind Call Knowledge Retrieval on Orchestrator, Excel Extractor, and Schedule Builder.

Run Form — MAS Deployment Health Check before activating the Orchestrator. Bind its Runtime endpoints → MAS — Runtime Config and the Header Auth credential on both webhook probes. Field target: PASS (0 FAIL, 0 TODO); PASS_WITH_TODO only means lab Docker DNS names are still in Runtime Config.
Keep every workflow inactive until placeholders and credentials are resolved. Activate Proxy, then Ingestion/Retrieval/Excel/Schedule/Error, then Orchestrator.
Engineers start tasks in Activity UI POST /cases (http://<IP>:8200).

Adding an agent (Phase 4): copy agents-template/demo_agent (FastAPI on mas-agent-kit) + n8n/templates/agents/<agent_id>.py (AgentSpec), run generate_<agent>.py, import the workflow, set <service_url_key> in MAS — Runtime Config, enable the row in Activity /registry (or PUT /agents/{agent_id}). Orchestrator is not regenerated. Long agents return status in_progress and finish with POST /cases/{id}/run {action:resume, source:agent, agent_result}.
activation_order: Import MAS — Runtime Config, fill Runtime URLs (field: Windows IP), bind Execute Workflow on Orchestrator/Excel/Schedule (Runtime Config) and Call Knowledge Retrieval → MAS — Knowledge Retrieval on Orchestrator, Excel Extractor, and Schedule Builder.
Create Header Auth credential Excel Tools X-API-Key and bind it on Agent — Excel Extractor HTTP nodes.
Activate MAS — Control Plane Proxy and POST {"operation":"schema"}.
Start Activity with CONTROL_PLANE_PROXY_URL; /health control_plane_backend = n8n_proxy.

Activate MAS — Knowledge Retrieval before Orchestrator and before Excel/Schedule LLM smokes (Call Knowledge Retrieval: orchestrator_routing / excel_protocol / schedule_mvp). Ingest cards via Activity.
Smoke Excel Extractor and Schedule Builder while Orchestrator is still inactive.
Activate Orchestrator — MAS last. Entry point is Activity UI, not a form.
smoke_expectations: Activity POST /cases with Excel + schedule_files + schedule_root stores artifacts on the control plane; specialists GET /cases/{id}/artifacts/{id}.
start without a usable objective asks the user via HITL (waiting_user), not a fabricated .INC.
Excel Extractor uses X-API-Key tools at /agent-tools/*; dates with an ISO time suffix become YYYY-MM-DD.
Schedule Builder commissioning and group-rebind emit in Python FastAPI (timeline_ops). JS timeline stays in n8n templates/smokes only.
INCLUDE text is not rewritten. Petrel ../../INCLUDE/... stays KEEP when bodies are not attached; URL/absolute paths are unsafe.
validated REVISE returns .INC plus completeness/preservation evidence; golden_case_1/2 match *_MAS_result.INC (WEFAC ignored).
Activity chat collapses duplicate agent.result / orchestrator.status+decision / double case.finished; rail turn_count matches that feed.

Control Plane Proxy snapshot is one SQL for case+events. Activity uses one SSE poller per case (2s running / 6s idle, wake on write) and batch for create/update+event. Successful proxy executions are not saved.
